title: Writing Task 1 - Line Graph: CO2 Emissions
description: IELTS Writing Task 1: Describe a line graph showing CO2 emissions from different energy sources over time.

stimuli.title: Task 1: CO2 Emissions by Energy Source (1990–2020)
stimuli.content:
You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

The line graph below shows CO2 emissions (in million tonnes) from three energy sources — coal, oil, and natural gas — in a European country between 1990 and 2020.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

Data summary: Coal: 450mt (1990), 380mt (2000), 290mt (2010), 180mt (2020). Oil: 320mt (1990), 340mt (2000), 310mt (2010), 260mt (2020). Natural gas: 120mt (1990), 150mt (2000), 170mt (2010), 155mt (2020).

questionGroups.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

questions.content: Describe the line graph showing CO2 emissions by energy source from 1990 to 2020.

keyFeatures: Coal emissions declined most sharply, falling from 450mt to 180mt over 30 years
Oil emissions remained relatively stable with a slight overall decrease
Natural gas rose from 120mt to a peak of 170mt in 2010, then fell slightly
By 2020, oil became the largest single source of CO2 emissions
